240-1879-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

4613-4687-5457.easyPrerequisites:
Gilder Bairn is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Selvala has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4687-5457.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
4613-4687-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Selvala using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling the counters on target permanent.
Repeat.

512-1432-7704.easyPrerequisites: Doc Samson and Ioreth of the Healing House do not have summoning sickness.
512-1432-7704.description:
Activate Doc Samson by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Ioreth of the Healing House and Doc Samson, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
512-1432-7704.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Doc Samson's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

2146-5078-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

2232-7827-7828-7830.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7828-7830.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4460-7795.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-7795.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Drider, triggering Breath of Fury and Drider.
Resolve the Drider trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink

1495-4613-7684.description:
Activate Tigra by using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Tigra triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

112-698-7426.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 3 or more life this turn.
112-698-7426.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {U} due to Will, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Berta triggers, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2642-4050-7527.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Spellbook Seeker // Careful Study, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

640-2180-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-2180-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Nearheath Stalker.
Nearheath Stalker dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Nearheath Stalker trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Nearheath Stalker, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-7354.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-7354.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Endless Foot Assault as attackers.
Endless Foot Assault triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1394-2060-2445-5231-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Branching Evolution.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Branching Evolution.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 9 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

2060-4518-6930-7183.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1308-2034-2267-5220-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
1308-2034-2267-5220-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Tormod triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

1492-2866-2981-4986.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
1492-2866-2981-4986.description:
Cast Welding Jar by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Welding Jar by sacrificing it.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Welding Jar from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

1287-4918-5902-6320.notablePrerequisites:
Innkeeper's Talent is level 3.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-4918-5902-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5686-5776-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
5686-5776-5777.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing any other creature.
Because the creature is a Food due to Ygra, when it dies, Camellia and Ygra trigger.
Resolve the Ygra trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Camellia trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Repeat.

907-1479-5671.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-5671.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, The Necrobloom, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and The Necrobloom trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

3263-3525-3784.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Vhal.
Vhal does not have summoning sickness.
3263-3525-3784.description:
Activate Vhal by tapping it, adding at least {3} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Vhal.
Repeat.

1622-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three permanents that can tap to produce a total of at least {3}.
1622-4846.description:
Cast Worldgorger Dragon by paying {3}{R}{R}{R}.
Worldgorger Dragon enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Minion Reflector.
Resolve Minion Reflector's trigger, paying {2} and creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
The Worldgorger Dragon token enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
In response, activate any mana-producing permanents you control, adding at least {3}.
Resolve the Worldgorger Dragon token's ability, exiling all of your other permanents.
When the nontoken Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, it triggers, doing nothing.
Resolve the nontoken Worldgorger Dragon's ETB trigger from step 2, exiling the token Worldgorger Dragon.
When the token Worldgorger Dragon leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning all of your permanents from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times.
End the loop by declining to pay for a Minion Reflector trigger.
If you control any other nontoken creatures, each of them triggers Minion Reflector in step 9 and you may wait to resolve them until after you have ended the loop and resolved the final Worldgorger Dragon ETB ability, creating an arbitrarily large number of creature tokens with haste.

224-3177-4270.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
224-3177-4270.description:
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Trade Routes' first ability by paying {1}, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Sakura-Tribe Scout by tapping it, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Sakura-Tribe Scout
Repeat.

787-3094.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
787-3094.description:
Activate Teferi, Temporal Archmage's second ability by removing a loyalty counter from it.
In response, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Teferi's activated ability.
Let the copied ability resolve, untapping three lands and Lithoform Engine.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any permanents in step 3.
